```plato
//==
// # Bounding regions
//
// Axis-aligned bounding regions (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bounding_volume)
// in 2D and 3D, over continuous and whole-number coordinates, plus the
// center-and-size rectangle. Bounds are inclusive on Min, inclusive on Max unless
// a doc comment says otherwise; the extent types they are measured in follow in
// the next section.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds (inclusive Min/Max; inverted
// Min>Max is the empty encoding and the Union identity).

// An axis-aligned bounding rectangle in 2D
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis-aligned_bounding_box). Inclusive on Min and
// Max. An inverted box (Min greater than Max on either axis) is the EMPTY
// encoding: it contains no point and is the identity for Union, so accumulation
// can start from Empty(). Prefer Bounds2D for culling/containment; prefer Rect2D
// (center+size) for layout. Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds.
type Bounds2D
    implements IBounds<Point2D, Vector2D>
{
    Min: Point2D;
    Max: Point2D;
}
```
